caption: The video captures a top-down view of a stainless-steel stockpot with two side handles resting on a gray surface, a dark curved burner ring visible beneath it. The pot holds a dark brown liquid, with a tan-yellowish foam mass floating near the center, made of two lobes each with a small dark hole and a thin tail trailing toward the lower right. A pale wooden block with partial printed text sits at the upper-left edge of the frame. A translucent steam haze hovers over the liquid and continuously billows, thinning and shifting its position from frame to frame. At times the vapor partially veils the left side, the top, or the right side of the foam and liquid. The floating foam stays present throughout, its lobes, dark holes, and tail remaining largely persistent with only subtle drift relative to the pot rim. The dark liquid surface shows slight shimmering movement beneath the foam and steam. The pot, handles, burner ring, and wooden block remain largely in place, with the camera essentially stationary aside from minor drift.
